conclusions: Eight gates and S0-S10 are finite planning exit obligations, explicitly not complete transitive implementation coverage.

External session origin and internal bootstrap/action capabilities are distinct; no report, hash, CLI/env flag, signed object without trusted issuer, constructed callback or JSON receipt may self-authorize.

Before-evaluation loader enforcement is separate from post-run actual-loaded corroboration. Independently rooted bootstrap/controller remains missing; no circular candidate self-attestation is introduced.

Dependency sequence correctly separates readiness review and separate live decision from original bootstrap replay/settlement, receipt continuity, fresh session grant check, connected phases and final exact-claim review.
Original guest/process restart or artifact export cannot preserve in-memory receipt capability. Observer/tracer/producer correspondence must be original inside one chosen domain.

Guest-local proof and a named existing-host-kernel proof are different claims; environment choice remains undecided and availability/adequacy uninspected. Same-kernel namespaces do not establish unisolated-host equivalence.

Actual unresolved source gap is correctly stated: run_traced may raise OwnedCleanupError while observe finalizer only checks control-worker inactivity before disposing handles/provenance. Local private error capture does not settle owned tracees.
Existing report, metadata, trace, asset and receipt bounds are separate. Journal implementation has no new allocation/whitelist/pin/timeout authorization; incompatible accounting blocks G4.
M1 names concrete trusted provider/owner contract, M2 cohesive ownership implementation remains guarded, M3 environment qualification/live work remains a separate decision.
